author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear looks at a new Porsche supercar! It’s the Marc Philipp Gemballa Marsien GT, a follow-up to the off-road-biased Marsien. That car took a Porsche 911 Turbo S, raised the suspension à la the 911 Dakar, and rebodied it in carbonfibre. Now the new Marsien GT focuses on road manners, bringing this £1m 911 back down to the ground, upping power to 900hp, and looking every bit like a modern-day Porsche 959!
